message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine which statutory charge(s) apply to the fact.

Fact: illegal harvesting of protected plant (楠木, a national second-level protected plant). The lexicon includes:

- 非法采伐、毁坏国家重点保护植物

That's exactly the charge. Also possibly "非法采伐、毁坏国家重点保护植物" is the only relevant. No other charges like illegal possession, etc. So answer: [罪名]非法采伐、毁坏国家重点保护植物<eoa>

Check if any other charge like "非法占用农用地" not relevant. So single charge.

Thus final answer.
